name: propulsion
description: Opinionated agentic coding workflow that guides software work from exploration and planning through execution and review.

interface.shortDescription: Opinionated workflow for agentic software development.
interface.longDescription: Propulsion automatically guides ordinary software requests through an opinionated agentic coding workflow: explore the codebase, resolve scope, create a plan, execute in focused slices, and review the result before handoff. It keeps agents grounded in repo context, explicit decisions, tests, and review loops.
